pipeline.authored: tools/pbr_author/extrude.py for the 243 stems in stems/minetest_game.txt (every texture a Minetest Game node draws as the base of a tile, less the water and lava strips its shaders own and the five 38 px door atlases), specs in specs/minetest_game/, classes frozen in stems/minetest_game.classes.json
pipeline.note: Replaces 1.1.0's 85 baked maps with the texel extrusion rule the Mineclonia pack uses. Specs were written on 2026-10-02 by seven Sonnet agents, one per material family, with every class checked against the art; the sandstones, cobble, furnace casing, planks and bookshelf were sent back once on review of their sheets. 1.1.0 provided 17 stems this does not: the ore, snow, litter, stones and wet soil side overlays, which Minetest Game draws only after a caret, where the client names the companion after the base image and never reads the overlay's maps, so nothing that reached the screen is lost. Judged on offline contact sheets; not yet on GPU frames or in play. Built from pbr_packs/minetest_game/textures as installed by build_pack.py --game minetest_game --install.

release.known_warnings_note: Dark art carries reviewed metalness: the visible art is two rows of light steel (luminance 0.59 to 0.81) and the dark the gate measures is the 192 transparent texels, so these stay metal.
